name: Motorcycle Simulator Illinois
summary:
Ride Chicago, Illinois, from the seat - alone or with your friends.

37 KM ROUND CHICAGO
North-west on the Kennedy, east on Irving Park Road past Wrigleyville, then south on Lake Shore Drive with Lake Michigan beside you - Lincoln Park, Oak Street Beach, over the Chicago River, Grant Park and Soldier Field. West on the Stevenson, north on the Dan Ryan past Chinatown with Willis Tower dead ahead.
